title: Fucking A

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use visual interference deliberately because difficult reading can carry tension when supporting identifiers remain available.
strategic_value: Red scratched lettering can give the production an abrasive character distinct from cleaner campaigns.
demonstration: Dense red scribbles partially obscure the large title on black; the playwright, director and small vertical signature sit at the bottom.
practical_value: Evaluate the tradeoff between expressive texture and immediate title legibility.

content_islands.name: Scratched title
content_islands.spec: Cover most of the black poster with red hand-drawn lines and partially legible title forms.

content_islands.name: Credits
content_islands.spec: Keep the red author and director lines and the small Public signature near the base.
